title: PS5 Pro vs PS5 vs Xbox Series X|S: where GTA 6 looks best
summary: All versions target 30 FPS. PS5 Pro adds sharper upscaling and exclusive ray-traced shadows.
body: - 1. PS5 Pro: PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution plus exclusive ray-traced shadows
- 2. PS5 and Xbox Series X: the baseline experience, 30 FPS target
- 3. Xbox Series S: same game, lower resolution
Rockstar has not announced a 60 FPS performance mode for launch. A later update could add one.
